Stop the dryer immediately, switch it off and unplug it if it’s safe to do so. Don’t run another cycle to test it. [P1] Leave it unplugged until it has cooled completely; if there’s no sign of fire, you can then clear fluff from the lint filter and check that the external air vents are clear. [P1] Don’t use it again until a qualified appliance technician has checked it. [P1]

If there’s smoke or flame, keep the door closed, leave the property and call 999. Don’t use water or try to move the dryer. [P1]

If you mean a Keel washing machine, finish any wash programme, empty the drum, leave it switched on and connect it to your home Wi‑Fi. In the Halvard Home app, select the machine and go to **Settings > Firmware update**. Tap **Install** if an update is available, and wait for the app to confirm it’s complete before using the machine. [P1]

If you mean an Ashby tumble dryer, finish any drying programme, empty the drum, and leave it switched on and connected to Wi‑Fi. On the dryer’s display, open **Settings > Software update > Check for updates**, then select **Install** if an update is available. Wait for the display to confirm completion before using it. [P2]

Switch on the child lock by pressing and holding the power button for 3 seconds while the Mira is switched on and stationary. A sound confirms the lock is active. It blocks the vacuum’s buttons, but scheduled cleaning and app controls remain available, so disable those too if you need to prevent automatic starts. [P1]

Keep your toddler away from the vacuum while it is moving, and don’t let children play with its controls. [P1][P2]

Yes. Water beneath the outdoor unit can be normal during or shortly after defrosting, when melted ice drains from the outdoor coil. [P1] Monitor it to see whether it stops; if water runs continuously, arrange an inspection by a qualified heat pump engineer. [P1]

Make sure the dishwasher is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi‑Fi. Then move your phone close to the dishwasher, turn on Bluetooth and allow any nearby-device or location permissions the app requests. Avoid guest Wi‑Fi, close and reopen the app, and try adding the dishwasher again. If it still doesn’t appear, switch it off at the mains for 30 seconds, then turn it back on. If the problem continues, contact Halvard Home support and explain what you tried. [P1]

Switch off the electricity supply at the consumer unit and keep it off until the hood is securely fitted and all electrical work is complete. [P1] Have a suitably qualified installer fit it, and arrange for a competent electrician to make any fixed electrical connection. [P1][P2]

Check the supplied installation guide for the required clearance above your hob; do not guess, and follow the cooking appliance’s positioning requirements too. [P1][P2] The hood must be at least 121 centimetres from a gas hob or open flame. [P2] Use fixings suitable for the wall, and have the installer check for hidden pipes, cables and other services before drilling. [P1][P2]

Check the hood and packaging for damage before installation; if anything appears wrong, leave it disconnected and contact Halvard Home. [P2] Make sure the socket is within 220 centimetres, remains accessible, and the cable is not stretched, trapped or exposed to heat; do not use an extension lead or adaptor. [P2]

Have the ventilation and ducting assessed, and follow the installation guide when routing any outlet outdoors. [P1][P2] Do not discharge air into a flue used by a fuel-burning appliance; seek professional advice if such appliances share the space. [P2][P3] Once fitted, remove the packaging, check that the filters are seated correctly, and test the fan and light. [P1]
A warranty repair will be completed within 37 working days of the fault being confirmed. [P1]
A regular service usually takes about 230 minutes. [P1]
The Orrin heat pump should be serviced every 42 months. [P1]
Wait 114 minutes before cleaning the hob, and do not clean it while the surface is still warm. [P1]
A routine service for the Corra induction hob costs **£210.00**. [P1]
Paid repairs to the Brio kettle are guaranteed for 122 days. The guarantee covers the work carried out and parts supplied as part of that repair. [P1]

The warranty provides free labour for repairs accepted under the warranty during the first 30 months from delivery. Covered parts may still be included after that, but labour charges can apply; Halvard Home should explain any charge before you agree to the repair. [P1]
Keep the original packaging for 8 days in case you need to return the cooker hood. [P1]
Change the filter every 13 weeks. [P1]

Extended Care Plus members are offered a routine service visit within 4 working days after Halvard Home accepts the service request and has the details needed to arrange it. [P1] A refund for a returned appliance is paid within 5 working days of it arriving at the warehouse. [P3]

Stop cooking and switch off the hob using its controls; remove pans only when it’s safe. Check that the control area is clean and dry, then try a reset by switching off the wall isolator for 60 seconds—only if it’s safely accessible. If the error returns, leave the hob switched off and contact Halvard Home support, noting exactly what the display shows and when it appears. Don’t remove the glass or attempt internal repairs. [P1]
The Fenwick cooker hood warranty period is unclear from the passages: one says two years from purchase [P1], while another says 66 months from delivery [P2].

For an Ashby tumble dryer, leave a short note asking visitors to:

- Check clothing care labels and remove anything unsuitable for tumble drying.
- Avoid overloading the drum and keep the area around the dryer clear.
- Clean the lint filter after every load.
- Stay in the property while the dryer runs and let the programme finish, including its cooling stage.
- Between bookings, check the drum is empty and the filter is clean; if the property will be empty for an extended period, switch off and unplug the dryer. [P1]

For a Keel washing machine, remind visitors to check the inlet and drain hoses for leaks or damage, turn on the water supply before washing, choose a programme suited to the care labels, and measure detergent for the load and local water hardness. Before they leave, they should remove laundry, check the drum, wipe the door seal, switch off the machine and turn off its water supply, then leave the door slightly open while keeping children and pets away. Arrange frost protection if the property may freeze. [P3]

Frost or ice inside a dishwasher is not normal. Don’t start a programme; switch it off and contact Halvard Home support for advice before using it again. Don’t use boiling water or sharp tools to remove the ice. [P1]

Stop the programme and note the exact error message. Switch off the dryer, unplug it, and wait five minutes. While it is unplugged and cool, clean the lint filter and check that accessible air vents are clear; if it has a water container, empty it and refit it securely. [P1]

Reconnect the dryer and try starting a programme once. If the message returns, stop using the appliance and contact Halvard Home support with the message and your model details. Don’t remove panels or attempt internal repairs; if you notice smoke or a burning smell, don’t restart it. [P1]
Keep the extractor running for 10 minutes after cooking to help clear lingering steam and smells. [P1]

Use the heating schedule to set the time you want heating to begin, rather than how long to wait. For example, to delay heating by one hour from 18:00, set the start time to 19:00, choose a target temperature, and save. Check that the schedule is enabled and applies to the correct day. [P1]
Hire a suitably qualified heat pump installer to disconnect, move and recommission your Orrin heat pump. [P1]

Check that the cooker hood’s wall switch or fused spur is on, then try the light and fan controls to see whether the whole hood has lost power or just the display. [P1]

Switch the hood off at its electrical supply for 60 seconds, then turn it back on and try the controls again. [P1] If the fan and light work but the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support and tell them which controls still respond. [P1]

If nothing works, check whether other kitchen appliances have power. Don’t remove covers or touch internal wiring; arrange a qualified inspection if the problem continues. [P1]
Yes. A factory reset clears the saved Wi-Fi details, heating schedules, and personal settings, so you’ll need to set them up again afterward. [P1]

Send the service team your hob’s full model details and a clear photo of the part you want to replace, if you still have it. Include a short description of the part; if it is missing, describe what it does. [P1] Confirm compatibility with your exact hob model before ordering. [P1]

Switch off the dryer, unplug it by the plug rather than pulling the lead, and let it cool completely. Remove the laundry, clean the lint filter, empty any water tank, and disconnect and secure any hoses and the power cable. [P1][P2]

Plan a clear route and protect the floor without making it slippery. Don’t lift or carry the dryer alone: use suitable handling equipment and get help. Keep it upright, protect the cabinet, and never lift it by the door, control panel, lead or attached fittings. [P1][P2]

At the new location, put it on a firm, level floor and reconnect it according to its installation instructions. Keep it disconnected for 38 hours after moving, then inspect the appliance, lead and connections for damage before use. [P1][P2]

Check that the controller is powered on, your phone is connected to your home Wi‑Fi, and Bluetooth is enabled. Keep your phone near the controller, allow the companion app any requested Bluetooth, nearby-device, or local-network permissions, then fully close and reopen the app and try adding the controller again. [P1] [P2]

If it still doesn’t appear, restart your phone and check for app updates. Contact the app’s support team if the problem continues, and tell them which steps you’ve tried. [P1]

To safely relocate your built-in Corra induction hob:

1. Switch it off at the mains and let the cooking surface cool. If it is hardwired, have a qualified electrician isolate and disconnect it; do not handle fixed wiring or pull on the cable yourself. [P1][P2]
2. Remove cookware and other loose items, clear the carrying route, and arrange suitable help. Have the installer release the hob’s fixings or seals—do not lift it while it is still secured. [P1][P2]
3. Lift it with assistance, supporting the parts intended for handling. Do not lift by the cable, controls or exposed glass edges, and do not tilt it more than 54 degrees. [P1][P2]
4. Protect the glass and casing with secure packaging, prevent the appliance from sliding or being struck, and place nothing on top. [P1][P2]
5. After transport, wait 17 hours before switching it on. Have a qualified installer check its condition and reinstall it safely; if it was dropped, struck, exposed to water or carried beyond the stated tilt limit, leave it disconnected and have it checked. [P2]

First, make sure your Mira vacuum is online in the Halvard Home app and that you can start a cleaning from the app. Then open your voice assistant’s app, find the option for adding smart-home devices, search for **Halvard Home**, and sign in with the same Halvard Home account you used to set up Mira. Allow access and ask the assistant to discover devices. Give the vacuum a simple name, such as “Mira,” then try saying, “Start Mira.” [P1]

If Mira doesn’t appear or respond, check its internet connection, then unlink Halvard Home in the assistant’s app and link it again. [P1]

Your extractor may get wet because warm, moist cooking air condenses on its cold surfaces. This is more noticeable in chilly weather, especially if the extraction duct runs through an unheated space. [P1]

If you’re leaving food inside, keep the refrigerator running, set it to 4°C, make sure the doors close fully, and remove food that will expire before you return. [P1]

If you’re emptying it for the long absence, switch it off and unplug it before cleaning. Remove all food, let any ice thaw, clean and dry the interior thoroughly, then leave the doors ajar to help prevent smells and mould. [P1]

When you return, let it reach its set temperature before putting chilled or frozen food back in. [P1]

To prepare your Keel washer for a safe move:

1. Switch it off at the socket and unplug it, then turn off the water supply and disconnect the inlet hose. Keep a towel and shallow tray nearby for water. [P1]
2. Drain the machine as described in its user manual, empty the drum and leave it dry. [P1]
3. Refit the original transit bolts according to the manual; they secure the drum during transport. If they are missing, contact Halvard Home before moving it. [P1]
4. Keep the washer upright, secure the hoses and cable so they cannot swing loose, and use two people to move it. [P1]
5. At the new home, remove the transit bolts before running a wash. [P1]
Icy or damp conditions can develop when warm, moist air enters the fridge freezer. Frequent door opening, uncovered food, or a poor door seal can make this worse. [P1]

Stop the programme and note which light or code is flashing. Let the drum stop, don’t force the door open, and check that the door is firmly closed and no clothing is trapped in the seal. If the warning continues, switch off and unplug the washer for 5 minutes. With power disconnected, check that the water tap is open and the inlet hose isn’t kinked. Reconnect and try the programme again; if the warning persists, contact Halvard Home support and tell them which light or code appeared and when. [P2]

Provide the extractor’s full model details from its rating label and the name of the accessory you need. If you’re unsure of the name, send a clear photo of the existing part and explain what you want to replace. [P1]

Ask support to confirm the part fits your model, is available, and what the total price including delivery and expected delivery time will be. [P1]

For your Mira robot vacuum, place it on its plugged-in charging dock. Hold the Power and Home buttons together for 10 seconds, then release them when you hear the reset announcement. Leave the vacuum on the dock while it restarts. A factory reset clears its saved Wi‑Fi details, schedules, and maps; afterwards, add it again in the Halvard Home app and reconnect it to Wi‑Fi. [P1]
Your refrigerator needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. [P1]

Check the dryer’s power supply first: make sure the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. [P1] If the socket works, unplug the dryer for 60 seconds, reconnect it, close the door firmly and try switching it on again. [P1]

Arrange for a qualified heat pump installer to disconnect your old heat pump and safely recover its refrigerant; don’t cut pipes, open the refrigerant circuit, or dismantle it yourself. [P1] Recycle it separately from household rubbish: ask your replacement installer about removal and recycling, or contact your local council for a service that accepts heat pumps. [P1] Check collection arrangements before moving it, keep it upright and away from children while awaiting collection, and use a licensed waste carrier if arranging transport yourself. [P1]
First, check the extractor’s power supply: make sure its wall switch or fused connection switch is on, and if it has a plug, confirm it is fully inserted—only if you can reach it safely. [P1]

Switch off the vacuum and remove it from the charging dock. Check the opening, hinges and catch for dust, hair or small objects, and wipe accessible edges with a dry, soft cloth. Make sure the dust bin is seated correctly and nothing sticks out above it, then lower the cover gently—don’t force it. If it still won’t stay down or a hinge or catch looks damaged, stop using the vacuum and contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

Use a heating schedule that matches your routine, with lower temperatures while you’re away or asleep. For a heat pump, keep temperatures fairly steady and try only a small overnight reduction rather than switching it off. [P1][P2]

Start around 19°C and adjust for comfort; lowering your usual setting by 1°C may reduce energy use if everyone still stays warm enough. [P1][P2] If you use a temporary override, return to your schedule afterward, and avoid turning the thermostat up sharply to heat faster. [P1] For a heat pump, keep it connected during cold weather and use its holiday setting—or a lower temperature—when you’re away. [P4]

Check for food, bottles, or packaging blocking the door, and make sure drawers and shelves are fully in place. Clean and dry the door seal and the surface it touches, and check for ice buildup—don’t force the door or use sharp tools to remove ice. [P1] If it still won’t close properly or the seal is split, contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

Contact Halvard Home customer support with your washer’s model details and a description of the part you need. Explain that you want an additional item, and ask them to confirm it fits your exact model, its availability, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time before you order. [P1]

Switch the tea maker off and unplug it, then let it cool completely. Lift it off its base and dry the outside; check whether water has run down from the spout or lid, and make sure you haven’t filled above the MAX mark. [P1]

If water keeps collecting underneath, stop using it and contact Halvard Home support. Don’t immerse the electrical base or try to repair it yourself. [P1][P2]

Unplug the teapot and let it cool completely, then empty it. Use a descaler labelled as suitable for kettles, following its instructions for the amount, water temperature and treatment time. Don’t overfill or mix cleaning products. [P1]

Afterwards, empty and rinse it thoroughly with fresh water. Fill it to the maximum mark, boil and discard the water, then repeat once before making drinks. Keep the base, plug and outside dry, and never immerse the teapot in water. [P1]

First, check the controller’s power supply: tap the display in case it is asleep, check or replace its batteries if it uses them, and make sure its clearly labelled power switch is on. [P1][P2] Don’t remove the cover or touch wiring. [P1][P2]

Connect the Tessa dishwasher to your home Wi-Fi, make sure no wash programme is running, empty it, and leave it switched on. On the control panel, go to **Settings > Firmware update > Check for updates**. If an update is available, select **Install** and follow the display instructions. Keep the power and Wi-Fi connected during installation, and wait for the display to confirm completion before starting a wash. [P1]

Stop the cycle and turn off the water supply tap. Switch off and unplug the machine only if the plug and surrounding area are dry; never touch a wet plug or socket. [P1]

When it’s safe, wipe up the water and, without moving the machine, check visible inlet hose connections, whether the drain hose has slipped out, and whether water is running from the detergent drawer (excess detergent can cause foaming and leaks). [P1]

Do not run another cycle while the leak is unexplained. If the hoses seem secure or water is coming from beneath the casing, contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

Pause the programme and wait for the drum to stop before checking the machine. If the door unlocks, spread heavy items evenly around the drum, then restart the programme—do not force the door open. Check that the machine is on a hard, level floor, all four feet touch the floor, and it does not rock when gently pushed at opposite corners. If it was newly installed, check the installation guide to confirm the transit bolts were removed. If strong vibration continues, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

Stop cleaning and switch off the vacuum. If the dock or plug is wet, switch off the mains socket before handling it. [P1]

Remove the water tank and empty it over a sink. Check that the filler cap is fully closed and inspect the tank and outlet for cracks. Wipe the tank and vacuum underside dry; don’t rinse the vacuum body or return it to the dock while wet. [P1]

If the tank is cracked, or it leaks again after you refit it securely, stop using the mopping function and contact Halvard Home support. [P1]
It needs a 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi network; it cannot connect to a network set to 5 GHz only. [P1]
Your Orrin heat pump warms your home gradually, so its radiators may feel cooler than radiators connected to a boiler; that alone does not necessarily indicate a fault. [P1]

Make sure the heat pump is on and your phone is connected to home Wi-Fi. Then try these steps in order: move closer to the heat pump; allow the app any requested Bluetooth or local network access in your phone settings; turn Wi-Fi off for 10 seconds and back on; fully close and reopen the app, then try adding the device again; and check for an app update. [P1]

If it still doesn’t appear, contact Halvard Home support and provide your phone model and what happens when you try to connect. [P1]

Make sure the washing machine is switched on and your phone is nearby. Connect your phone to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network (5 GHz won’t work for setup), turn on Bluetooth, and allow the app to access nearby devices. Then close and reopen the app and try adding the machine again, following the in-app pairing instructions. [P1]

If it still doesn’t appear, restart your phone and router and try again once Wi-Fi is available. If the problem continues, contact Halvard Home support with your phone model and a description of where setup stops. [P1]
No. The Halvard Home Brio kettle does not have a timer or delay-start setting; you must switch it on manually when you want to boil water. [P1]
Yes. A gentle rumbling or hissing sound while your Brio kettle heats up is usually normal. [P1]

Before installing your Halvard Home Ashby tumble dryer:

1. Read the supplied installation instructions and check that the chosen space meets the required clearances. [P1]
2. Check the appliance and packaging for damage. If the casing or door is damaged, or electrical parts are exposed, do not connect it; report the damage and keep it disconnected. [P2]
3. Choose a dry, ventilated indoor location, away from weather, water splashes, heat sources and open flames. Keep it at least 113 centimetres from a gas hob or open flame, and install it within 297 centimetres of its socket. [P2]
4. Put it on a firm, level floor and adjust its feet until it stands securely without rocking. Keep ventilation openings unobstructed and leave the space specified in the instructions. [P1][P2]
5. Remove all packaging from inside and around the drum, and keep the area clear of packaging and combustible materials. [P1][P2]
6. Arrange any vent hose or water-drainage connection as directed in the instructions; do not crush, twist or trap connections. [P1][P2]
7. Plug the dryer directly into a suitable earthed wall socket, with the plug accessible and the lead unstretched and untrapped. Do not use an extension lead or adaptor. If the cable is damaged or the electrical supply is uncertain, leave it disconnected and seek qualified help. [P1][P2]
8. Before first use, wipe the empty drum with a soft, damp cloth. [P1]

Stop the programme, switch off and unplug the dryer, and let it cool. Clean and securely refit the fluff filter; if your model has a water tank, empty and refit it. Check that clothing isn’t trapped in the door, then close the door firmly. Reconnect the dryer and try the programme again. If the light keeps flashing, stop using the appliance and contact Halvard Home support, describing which light flashes and when it appears. [P1]

A rattling, thumping or scraping noise can be caused by loose items such as coins or keys, metal zips or buttons hitting the drum, an uneven load, or the dryer touching nearby furniture. [P1]

Stop the programme, switch off and unplug the dryer, then let the drum cool before checking for loose items. Redistribute bulky items evenly, and check that the dryer stands level and is not touching a wall or cupboard. [P1]

If the noise continues or you hear loud grinding, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

Water underneath your Vale fridge freezer may be from a spill, a blocked defrost drain, or a door that isn’t closing properly. [P1] A blocked drain, incorrectly fitted filter, or damaged connection can also cause water to collect inside or beneath it. [P2]

Switch off and unplug the machine. If you’ve used a hot wash, let the water cool completely. Open the lower-front filter flap with towels and a shallow tray underneath, then loosen the filter slowly so trapped water can drain. Remove debris, rinse the filter, wipe the filter opening, and refit the filter securely without forcing it. Close the flap, reconnect power, and run a short rinse to check for leaks. [P1]

If draining is still slow, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support. [P2]
Your old Halvard Home Corra induction hob should be recycled as electrical equipment, not placed in your household rubbish bin. [P1]

A rattling or banging noise can be caused by loose objects, an uneven load, or the machine not being level. [P1]

Pause the programme and wait until the drum stops and the door unlocks—never force the door open. Spread heavy items evenly around the drum and check for coins, keys, or other loose objects. [P1] If the machine rocks when gently pressed at a corner, switch it off and unplug it before adjusting its feet. [P1] For a newly installed machine, check the installation guide to confirm the transit bolts have been removed. [P1]

Switch the dryer off at the socket before unplugging it, and use a torch—not a candle—to check the area. [P1]

If it is safe to open the door, carefully remove the laundry, which may be hot, and spread it out so heat can escape. [P1]

Once the electricity supply is stable, plug the dryer back in, check the laundry, and choose a suitable programme if it needs more drying. [P1]

If you notice a burning smell or visible damage, leave the dryer unplugged and contact Halvard Home support. [P1]

A factory reset erases saved heating schedules and temperature preferences, so note them down first. [P1]

1. Make sure the heat pump is on and not displaying a warning. [P1]
2. On the controller, open **Settings**, then select **System** > **Factory reset**. [P1]
3. Choose **Confirm** and leave the power connected while the controller restarts. [P1]
4. When the home screen returns, check the date and time, then re-enter your preferred temperatures and heating schedule. [P1]

If **Factory reset** is unavailable or the controller does not restart, contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the unit or change installer settings to force a reset. [P1]

To switch the child lock on, make sure the kettle is not heating, then press and hold the lock button for three seconds. The lock indicator lights up to confirm it is on. [P1]

To switch it off, press and hold the same button for three seconds, until the indicator goes out. [P1]

Make sure your fridge freezer is connected to your home Wi-Fi and has a steady power supply. On the control panel, open **Settings**, select **Software update**, then choose **Check for updates** and follow the on-screen instructions if an update is available. [P1]
